content.text: Found it: `handleClick` only resets `busy` in the `.then()` success path; there's no `.catch()`/`finally`, so a rejected promise (failed export) leaves `busy` stuck `true` forever.

result.label: bug
result.what_to_change: In handleClick, use a .catch/.finally (or try/catch) around exportReport so that setBusy(false) runs even when the export promise rejects, and show an error toast instead of leaving the button disabled.
result.evidence: handleClick calls exportReport(reportId, format).then(() => { setBusy(false); ... }) with no catch/finally; exportReport throws on non-2xx responses, so on failure the promise rejects, setBusy(false) never runs, and the button (disabled={busy}) stays greyed out until reload.
